title: Tranche-aligned Q2 roadmap for Private Tenant Gateway: cadence, OKRs, and rollout gates
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Objective: Define a tranche-aligned quarterly roadmap and cadence for shipping the Private Tenant Gateway (PTG) — a hardened on-prem/VPC connectivity and lifecycle orchestration surface aimed at enterprise customers requiring tenant isolation, deterministic upgrade windows, and KMS/HSM-backed keying.

Scope: cadence and milestone plan for Q2 2026 that covers: onboarding flow for isolated tenants, interop with existing Dedicated routing policies, upgrade/rollout windows and compatibility gates, audit/audit-log retention policy, key rotation integration with KMS, and a canary/rollback playbook for tenant upgrades.

OKRs mapped to this roadmap:
- Objective 1: Deliver a repeatable activation runway for isolated tenants with predictable downtime <= 30 minutes during planned upgrades.
  - KR1.1: >80% of pilot tenants complete activation without engineering intervention.
  - KR1.2: 99.9% success rate for scheduled upgrade automation in the staging cohort.
- Objective 2: Ensure security and compliance readiness for regulated customers.
  - KR2.1: Complete KMS/HSM integration and customer key mode for at-rest encryption by end of cycle.
  - KR2.2: Provide audit-log retention options to 7 years and export hooks to SIEMs.
- Objective 3: Reduce private-instance per-token cost variance through routing and batching policies.
  - KR3.1: Ship dynamic routing policy toggles and cost telemetry; show 12% median unit cost improvement for tier-1 workloads.

Milestones (tranche-aligned):
- Tranche A (Pilot, end of April): tenant onboarding API (v1), basic RBAC, staging activation runbook, initial telemetry dashboards.
- Tranche B (Scale, mid-May): KMS key mode, enhanced audit logs, upgrade canary tooling with automatic rollback, per-tenant routing profiles.
- Tranche C (GA prep, end of June): compliance packaging (artifact checklist), SLA documentation, customer-facing activation playbook, blue-green upgrade automation.

Acceptance criteria (high level):
- Onboarding: new tenant can be provisioned via API + console within 2 hours using documented steps; no manual infra steps required in >80% of cases.
- Upgrades: automated upgrade runbook completes within defined maintenance window and preserves data/response parity; automatic rollback triggered on >5% regression in latency or error rate.
- Security: all tenant secrets stored via KMS integration; HSM-backed signing available for pilot customers.
- Observability: per-tenant dashboards for cost, latency, error budget; alerting templates included for SRE handoffs.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Tenant network heterogeneity (on-prem networking) causing activation failures. Mitigation: Add network pre-flight checks and a troubleshooting checklist; include an opt-in low-latency tunnel mode for early pilots.
- Risk: KMS integration edge-cases across cloud providers. Mitigation: Start with AWS KMS and a pluggable interface; schedule cross-cloud test matrix during Tranche B.
- Risk: Upgrade regressions at scale. Mitigation: Canary traffic split + shadow mode + synthetic workload regression tests tied to automatic rollback thresholds.

Stakeholders & owners:
- PM: Devon Patel (roadmap owner)
- Eng leads: Priya Rao (runtime), Marcus Lee (deployments), Elena Gomez (security infra)
- Design: Hema Singh (console flows)
- SRE/Operations: Carter Huang
- Sales/CS liaison: Maya Ocampo

Telemetry & success signals (what we will measure each week):
- Activation lead time (API->tenant active) median and 90th percentile.
- Upgrade success rate and time-to-rollback on failures.
- Per-tenant unit cost variance vs baseline.
- Number of customer support escalations tied to onboarding/upgrade.

Rollout waves and gating:
- Wave 0: Internal dogfood tenants and SRE-owned pilot (Tranche A).
- Wave 1: 5 strategic customers as early access (Tranche B) with SSO/SAML vetting.
- Wave 2: Broader GA cohorts with tiered support and documented SLA (Tranche C).

Post-launch operations:
- Runbook for activation failures and rollback playbook committed to runbooks repo.
- Quarterly health review dashboard with automated anomaly detection on per-tenant metrics.
- Postmortem policy: any customer-impacting rollout that breaches error-budget will trigger a blameless postmortem and a stakeholder remediation plan within 5 business days.
